disposition: Correct the demonstrably erroneous expected label; preserve the original fixture and do not drop the case
proof_application: N=10 and five capacities are odd. The official theorem for N>=4 makes the first player the winner when the odd count is odd. The corrected source problem starts with Fennec.
independent_method: Exact minimax on every reachable state (sorted unvisited capacities, total remaining capacity of already visited indices), without using the parity theorem
